long.title: Side Hustle, No 1099? You Still Owe $2,387
long.desc:
Quick question: if no tax form shows up for your side hustle, do you still owe tax? Yes or no? Tell me in the comments.

Free self-employment tax calculator: https://bookkeepingsheets.com/self-employment-tax-calculator/
Mileage deduction calculator (72.5¢ and 76¢ for 2026): https://bookkeepingsheets.com/mileage-deduction-calculator/
Quarterly estimated tax calculator: https://bookkeepingsheets.com/quarterly-estimated-tax-calculator/

The IRS says you must report all income, whether or not you get a Form 1099. For 2026: Form 1099-K from payment apps and marketplaces comes only after more than $20,000 AND more than 200 payments; Form 1099-NEC after $2,000; card payments have no minimum. Real example: $27,600 of side income, only $9,800 on a form, $16,895 profit = $2,387.19 self-employment tax plus income tax.

a.title: No 1099? The IRS Still Sees It
a.desc:
Did you know this? Tell me in the comments.

Forms go to you AND the IRS, and computers match them to your return. Missing income gets a CP2000 notice. And if you're under the limits, the income is still taxable.
